conflicts.quote: dm.at (same GTIN 4015100812435, Henkel CEE Wien): 'Aqua (Water, Eau),Sodium Laureth Sulfate,Cocamidopropyl Betaine,Sodium Chloride,Dimethicone,Hydrolyzed Keratin,Combretum Farinosum Flower Nectar,PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate,Parfum (Fragrance),Sodium Benzoate,Citric Acid,Amodimethicone,Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride,Hydrogenated Castor Oil,Glycol Distearate,Laureth-4,PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate,Glycerin,Laureth-23,Trideceth-10, Sodium Hydroxide,Limonene,Benzyl Salicylate,Phenoxyethanol,Hexyl Cinnamal,Propylene Glycol,Sodium Salicylate,Benzyl Alcohol, Potassium Sorbate' - differs from the German list: different order (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate before Parfum, Hydrogenated Castor Oil before Glycol Distearate), has Benzyl Salicylate and Hexyl Cinnamal, lacks Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil. Pilot packet 2026-09-03 additionally recorded brack.ch (CH) with a differing formula (text not re-fetched).
conflicts.resolution: Austrian/Swiss regional or older formula for the same EAN, not merged. German manufacturer + dm.de agree verbatim and are canonical for the German market.

canonicalReason: schwarzkopf.de (manufacturer DE, exact 250 ml, GTIN in schema.org) and dm.de (same GTIN) agree verbatim on the complete 28-item list; identical to the 2026-09-03 pilot packet. dm.at conflicts but is Austrian (different responsible company).
normalization: Split the canonical INCI on ',' (or '|' / '•' separators where the source uses them; dm renders a non-breaking hyphen as '|' inside names, e.g. 'COCO|GLUCOSIDE' = 'Coco-Glucoside'); per ingredient: trim, collapse internal whitespace, merge split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' stays one item), strip trailing full stop; canonicalInci keeps the published capitalisation/asterisks; for the hash each item is lower-cased; items joined with '|' and sha256 over the UTF-8 string.
notes: Contains Dimethicone + Amodimethicone (silicones). Claim-INCI check: 'flüssiges Keratin' = Hydrolyzed Keratin, 'Blütennektar' = Combretum Farinosum Flower Nectar, both present; 'reduziert Haarbruch' is a performance claim. No missing named ingredient.
Same EAN carries different formulas in AT/CH vs DE: anyone scanning the EAN abroad would see a different list. Relevant if the scanner ever resolves by EAN only.
Manufacturer page does not state the dm article; no pack photo inspected.
